goals.name: Market Research Goal Harness
goals.description: Market Research Goal Harness [gtm-market-research] — compiled from capabilities/harnesses/hD-09-market-research.yaml
goals.gate: Synthesis shipped with source-tiered claims, corroboration, contradictions, sizing math, and uncertainty labels

gates.name: 0.1 Research question framed as a decision: what decision this r
gates.description: Research question framed as a decision: what decision this research feeds and what would change it
gates.command: artifacts/market/<run>/question.md with decision, change_conditions fields non-empty

gates.name: 0.2 Research doctrine loaded (market-research, research-ops, sou
gates.description: Research doctrine loaded (market-research, research-ops, source tiering rules)
gates.command: grep -q 'primary' ~/.claude/skills/market-research/SKILL.md && echo LOADED in session log

gates.name: 0.3 RIG coordinate stated (L2-L3; D2-D3; A1-A3)
gates.command: coordinate block in ~/.hermes/jake/market/session-<ts>.log parseable by jq

gates.name: 0.4 Harness tuple H_market declared with all 8 components
gates.description: Harness tuple H_market declared with all 8 components

gates.name: 1.1 Source inventory tiered before reading: primary (filings, go
gates.description: Source inventory tiered before reading: primary (filings, gov data, direct data), secondary (analyst, trade press), tertiary (blogs, vendor content) — labeled per source
gates.command: artifacts/market/<run>/sources.json — every source has tier enum, url, accessed_at; jq '[.[] | .tier] | unique | length >= 2' true

gates.name: 1.2 Primary-source floor: >= 2 tier-1 sources underpin the load-
gates.description: Primary-source floor: >= 2 tier-1 sources underpin the load-bearing claims

gates.name: 1.3 Corroboration rule: every load-bearing claim backed by >= 2
gates.description: Corroboration rule: every load-bearing claim backed by >= 2 independent sources (not one source citing another)
gates.command: artifacts/market/<run>/claims.json — each claim.source_ids length >= 2 and sources verified independent (different publishers)

gates.name: 1.4 Contradiction log: conflicting data points across sources re
gates.description: Contradiction log: conflicting data points across sources recorded, not silently averaged away
gates.command: artifacts/market/<run>/contradictions.md lists each conflict with both values and sources, or explicit 'none found' note

gates.name: 2.1 TAM/SAM/SOM computed with stated method per layer (top-down,
gates.description: TAM/SAM/SOM computed with stated method per layer (top-down, bottom-up, or value-theory) and all assumptions enumerated
gates.command: artifacts/market/<run>/sizing.md — per layer: method, formula, inputs with source ids, computed value; python3 scripts/verify_sizing.py exit 0

gates.name: 2.2 Sensitivity stated: which single assumption moves the answer
gates.description: Sensitivity stated: which single assumption moves the answer most, with the swing quantified
gates.command: sizing.md contains '## Sensitivity' with the dominant assumption and its swing range

gates.name: 2.3 Currency of data verified: every quantitative input dated; i
gates.description: Currency of data verified: every quantitative input dated; inputs older than the declared staleness threshold are flagged
gates.command: claims.json inputs each have as_of date; flagged_stale array present (may be empty)

gates.name: 3.1 Synthesis doc written with claim-to-source map: every sectio
gates.description: Synthesis doc written with claim-to-source map: every section's key claims carry source id citations
gates.command: artifacts/market/<run>/synthesis.md — grep -c '\[S[0-9]' >= number of ## sections; zero uncited key claims

gates.name: 3.2 Uncertainty labels applied: every forward-looking statement
gates.description: Uncertainty labels applied: every forward-looking statement tagged [FACT | INFERENCE | SPECULATION]
gates.command: synthesis.md forward-looking lines carry exactly one tag; scripts/uncertainty_lint.py exit 0

gates.name: 3.3 Refute pass: a second pass actively attempts to falsify the
gates.description: Refute pass: a second pass actively attempts to falsify the top 3 conclusions with counter-evidence
gates.command: artifacts/market/<run>/refute.md — per conclusion: attempted falsification, counter-evidence found or not, verdict

gates.name: 3.4 Provenance bundle sealed: all source snapshots (html/pdf) ar
gates.description: Provenance bundle sealed: all source snapshots (html/pdf) archived locally with hashes
gates.command: artifacts/market/<run>/snapshots/ contains per-source files; shasum -a 256 -c snapshots.sha256 exit 0

preconditions.startup_phrase: Market research session. Sources before synthesis, math before narrative, uncertainty stated before confidence implied.
preconditions.harness_tuple: H_market(question, source_tiers, corroboration, contradictions, sizing, provenance, synthesis, uncertainty)
preconditions.bms_bias: A1 for provenance and math; A2 for extraction; A3 for synthesis narrative; A4 never — published conclusions require human sign-off

self_improvement.update_trigger: same gate fails 3+ times; a load-bearing claim later proven wrong triggers a provenance-pipeline audit

success_conditions: Synthesis shipped with source-tiered claims, corroboration, contradictions, sizing math, and uncertainty labels
Provenance bundle sealed and hash-verified; refute pass recorded
Research question answered with a decision-relevant recommendation or an explicit 'insufficient evidence' verdict
Identity closure: coordinate, verdict (answered | provisional | insufficient-evidence), next safe action in session log
failure_states: halt gate(s) 1.1, 1.2, 1.3, 2.1, 2.3, 3.1, 3.2, 3.4: no progress without gate evidence
quality_criteria: Research question framed as a decision: what decision this research feeds and what would change it
Research doctrine loaded (market-research, research-ops, source tiering rules)
Harness tuple H_market declared with all 8 components
Source inventory tiered before reading: primary (filings, gov data, direct data), secondary (analyst, trade press), tertiary (blogs, vendor content) — labeled per source
Primary-source floor: >= 2 tier-1 sources underpin the load-bearing claims
Corroboration rule: every load-bearing claim backed by >= 2 independent sources (not one source citing another)
Contradiction log: conflicting data points across sources recorded, not silently averaged away
TAM/SAM/SOM computed with stated method per layer (top-down, bottom-up, or value-theory) and all assumptions enumerated
Sensitivity stated: which single assumption moves the answer most, with the swing quantified
Currency of data verified: every quantitative input dated; inputs older than the declared staleness threshold are flagged
Synthesis doc written with claim-to-source map: every section's key claims carry source id citations
Uncertainty labels applied: every forward-looking statement tagged [FACT | INFERENCE | SPECULATION]
Refute pass: a second pass actively attempts to falsify the top 3 conclusions with counter-evidence
Provenance bundle sealed: all source snapshots (html/pdf) archived locally with hashes

final_rule: No load-bearing claim ships on a single source.
No sizing number without its formula, inputs, and dominant sensitivity.
Uncertainty labels are mandatory; confidence without a tag is a fabrication risk.
Every market research session leaves the system stronger than it found it.
